title: Agent-self-audit checkpoint result
description: What one subagent writes after loading a Skill and applying it to a checkpoint's targets. self_audit_agent.py aggregate reads + validates these; an untrusted-LLM-output boundary, so the schema is strict (additionalProperties: false).

checkpoint_id.description: Echoes the dispatch.json brief id this result answers.

skill.description: The skill the subagent loaded + applied.

status.description: clean = zero findings; findings = one or more; error = audit could not complete (explain in summary).

findings.description: Concrete violations the subagent found. Empty when status is clean.

detail.description: Multi-line context: what the skill says, where the code diverges, why it matters.

files.description: File paths the finding applies to (and line ranges when known).

remediation.description: Concrete one-line action that would resolve the finding.
